rss: Royal Mail misses delivery targets again but hails 'encouraging' signs
title: Package Playtime: Delivery Delays!
story: DLVR tried hard to deliver packages faster. But, some kids had to wait longer for their toys. The company promises to be better soon.
storyBig: DLVR has been working to improve its delivery times. However, they still missed their goals, which can affect customer satisfaction and future orders.
think: Why is it important for deliveries to be on time?
bull: When packages arrive on time, everyone is happy!
bear: If packages keep arriving late, customers might get frustrated.

rss: Panama Canal to cut number of ships passing through due to El Niño
title: Fewer Boats Mean Slower Sodas!
story: FIZZ might take longer to restock because boats carrying soda are delayed by low water levels.
storyBig: Due to reduced rainfall, fewer ships can pass through the main shipping route, causing delays for goods like sodas to reach their destinations.
think: How can water levels affect the time it takes for things to arrive?
bull: When the soda finally arrives, it will be extra refreshing!
bear: Waiting for your favorite drink can be tough if it takes too long to arrive.
